## Data Availability

### Common Countries by Year

The bar height counts country-years flagged reliable in ESS with both WID series
available. Labels show `reliable (matched / invalid)`, for example `15 (18/3)`.

```{r}
#| label: coverage-countries-per-year-plot
#| echo: false
if (length(data_coverage$plot_files)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(data_coverage$plot_files[["countries_per_year"]])
}
```

### Common Years by Country

The bar length counts reliable ESS years with matched WID data for each country.
Labels show `reliable (matched / invalid)` year counts.

```{r}
#| label: coverage-years-per-country-plot
#| echo: false
if (length(data_coverage$plot_files)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(data_coverage$plot_files[["years_per_country"]])
}
```
